records.explanation: Spend on the "plant identifier" keyword across all campaigns, converted to US dollars at each day's exchange rate, came to about $3,061.40 for the period 2026-08-28 to 2026-10-26.
records.sql: select sum(d.spend / fx.units_per_usd) as spend_usd from reporting.keyword_daily d join reporting.keywords k using (keyword_id) join reporting.ad_groups g using (ad_group_id) join reporting.campaigns c using (campaign_id) join reporting.fx_rates fx on fx.day = d.day and fx.currency = c.currency where k.keyword = 'plant identifier' and d.day between '2026-08-28' and '2026-10-26'
